content.text:
`slugify` is now implemented in `src/strings.js`, and `npm test` passes: 13 of 13, including 11 new slugify tests in `test/strings.test.js`.

It lowercases the text and strips diacritics. `đ` becomes `d` before the accent removal, because `đ` has no decomposed form that the accent-stripping step would catch. Every run of characters outside a-z and 0-9 becomes one hyphen. Leading hyphens are dropped before the 50-character cut, and trailing hyphens are dropped after it, so a slug cut at 50 never ends in a hyphen.

The tests cover the basic case, Vietnamese and other Latin diacritics, `đ`/`Đ`, runs of symbols, trimming, digits, empty and symbol-only input, and the 50-character cut.

Non-string input is converted with `String()` rather than rejected, so `slugify(null)` returns `"null"`.

It lowercases the text and strips diacritics. `đ` becomes `d` before the accent removal, because `đ` has no decomposed form that the accent-stripping step would catch. Every run of characters outside a-z and 0-9 becomes one hyphen. Leading hyphens are dropped before the 50-character cut, and trailing hyphens are dropped after it, so a slug cut at 50 never ends in a hyphen.

The tests cover the basic case, Vietnamese and other Latin diacritics, `đ`/`Đ`, runs of symbols, trimming, digits, empty and symbol-only input, and the 50-character cut.
